name: A same-session world entry does not resend the patch stream (#5737, #6394)
contract: The Extensions DLL writes each SMSG_PATCH_SPELL row into the client's in-memory Spell.dbc (On92A), which
the client loads once at start-up and no world entry restores, so a patched row stays for the whole client
session. The DLL still sends CMSG_EXTENSION_INITIALIZED (0x561) after every world entry, including each
loading screen. Answering every notice with the full stream (about 4,600 Spell rows, 4 MB) froze the
client for seconds on every dungeon portal. The stream is sent once per login: the relog scenario covers
a new login receiving it again. This scenario waits for the first world entry's stream, checks that it
carried the Mortal Form row 500125, sends the world-entry notice again in the same session and asserts
that no further row 500125 arrives, past the old ten-second resend cooldown.

steps.label: Let the first world entry and its patch stream settle
The first world entry streams the Mortal Form row
DISCRIMINATING: the same-session world entry is not answered with the stream again
